answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if peer graders detect coordinated fake identities. Like light through a prism, one operator splitting into many accounts splits the same capital into thinner, weaker bonds. An ivory tower of cheap pseudonyms collapses because every extra identity must post fresh stake and survive a challenge period, so a nebula of fakes costs linearly more than it can earn and loses money before gaining influence.
